newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo rises on 64-bit game sales plan.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo rises on 64-bit game sales plan.

text.p: Shares in Nintendo Co Ltd rose in Tuesday morning trade, inspired by the company's plans to start selling its new 64-bit video game machine "Nintendo64" in Europe on March 1, 1997, brokers said.
As of 0146 GMT, the shares were up 330 yen at 7,430 yen with a trade volume of 250,300 shares.

The machine will be sold in Germany for 399 marks, a Nintendo spokesman said. He did not give prices for other countries or an estimate for sales of the machine in Europe. Nintendo introduced the machine, its newest, in Japan on June 23 and will launch it in the United States on September 29.
